meta.title: Paladin data sheet for WoW Forever (level 60 vs a level 63 training dummy): Retribution, Protection (tank) and Shockadin
meta.scope: Seals and Judgement, every ability a level-60 paladin uses against a raid boss, procs, mana economy, what an attacking dummy needs for a Protection tank, the three talent trees in gunba's order, all sim builds plus a proposed Shockadin, priority lists, default stats and worked examples. Holy (healing) is out of scope; its talents are listed because talent strings need them.
meta.howToRead: Every number is an object {value, unit, source, confidence, note}. 'source' is a GitHub permalink (repo@commit/path#Lline), a URL, or a list of them. 'confidence' is one of the three values in confidenceLegend. Spell rows cited as fs sim/core/spelldata/spells_auto_gen.go are the beta client rows (build 1.60.1.70124) stored in foreversim.

confidenceLegend.confirmed-forever: Stated by Forever client data (spell rows, talent curves), a Wowhead Forever tooltip, Blizzard (development notes), or measured on the beta. Most beta measurements were taken at levels 8-30; level-60 values are datamined or extrapolated unless noted.
confidenceLegend.sim-provisional: A modelling choice of one or both sims with no Forever source yet, or where the two sims disagree. Use it, but expect it to change.
confidenceLegend.classic-fallback: Forever data is silent, so the sims keep the Classic 1.12 / Classic Era value.

simsCompared.gs: gunba/wow-forever-sim (branch 'forever'), commit 9c05fc890b (2026-10-09). Engine: wowsims/classic + ElliotWood/Forever. Static client tables pinned to 1.60.1.70170; follows the 24 Sep, 1 Oct and 8 Oct development notes.
simsCompared.fs: laurencestokes/foreversim (branch 'master'), commit 255df1627f (2026-10-01). Engine: wowsims/forever, carries the beta client rows (1.60.1.70124). Same paladin tree order as gs (Holy 17, Protection 16, Retribution 17), so its strings decode on the current tree, but a few talent values are pre-1-October (Redoubt 6%/rank, Champion of the Light 33/66/100% incl. healing, Iron Creed 3%/rank).

practiceYardSummary: Judgement does NOT consume the seal in Forever, is off the GCD, 10 s cooldown (8 s with Improved Judgement 2/2), 6% of base mana (91). Judgements of Righteousness, Command and Fury roll on the melee table (miss and 2.0x crit, never dodged/parried/blocked).

Seal twisting is a talent: Twist of Light (Ret 31). Replacing Seal of Command, Righteousness, Fury or Justice banks a one-charge Echo of that seal; your next landed white swing applies the Echo too. The Ret loop swaps Seal of Command and Seal of Righteousness every swing (each seal 1.5 s GCD, 20% cheaper with the talent).

Holy Strike is a new baseline melee ability: 50% x (normalized weapon damage + 81-105) Holy, 20 mana, 10 s cooldown, 1.5 s GCD, melee table (can be dodged/parried), Holy Power +3%/rank crit, Sacred Arbiter +20%.

Seal of Command: 7 procs per minute (beta logs 6.75), 1 s ICD, white swings only, 70% weapon damage + 0.29 x 70% of spell power, own melee roll, 2.0x crit. Seal of Righteousness: 18.8 per 100 weapon speed x 1.2 (two-hand) or x0.85 (one-hand) per landed white swing, cannot miss, can crit (2.0x).

Protection: Righteous Fury +60% Holy threat; Holy Shield +30% block, 4 charges, 221 Holy damage per block, 10 s/10 s; Redoubt +20% block after a landed hit (10%); Shield Specialization 6% max mana per block (3 s ICD); Reckoning extra attacks on block/crit (1.5 s ICD); Templar's Bulwark absorb = 100% max health. The tank dummy must swing at you.

Shockadin: Holy Shock is a 21-point Holy talent with a 10 s cooldown (Classic 30 s): rank 4 334-362 Holy + 0.429 SP, 325 mana, spell table (17% miss vs +3; Divine Precision 3/3 = +18% Holy spell hit), 1.5x crit, Holy Power +15% crit, Divine Favor = guaranteed crit every 2 min. No sim models a Shockadin; the builds here are our proposals.
meta.wowheadLevelNote: Wowhead Forever's 'Level 60' tooltip prints scaling spells at the rank's maximum scaling level (Seal of Command 5 judgement 388-422 stunned = level 68; Seal of Righteousness 8 judgement 187-203 = level 64; Holy Strike 97-121; Exorcism 491-545; Hammer of Wrath 489-538). The sims use the value at character level 60 (339-373 stunned, 170-186, 81-105, 474-530, 473-523). Wowhead's TALENT tooltips print raw spell base points that are stale for curve-based ranks (Iron Creed 30%/15%, Vengeance 5%, Champion of the Light 100%, Spiritual Focus 14%); the gs tree (client trait curves) is used instead.

baseStatsLevel60.note: Classic level-60 paladin base. Base mana 1512 is what '% of base mana' costs use: Judgement 6% = 91, Righteous Fury 30% = 454, Divine Favor 4% = 60, Blessing of Kings 8% = 121, Seal of Justice 13% = 197. AP = 160 + 2 x Strength.

races.note: Undead paladins are new in Forever. Offsets vs Human: Dwarf Str +2 Agi -4 Sta +3 Int -1 Spi -1; Undead Str -1 Agi -2 Sta +1 Int -2 Spi +5. Human Sword Specialization = +2% all crit with a sword; Dwarf Mace Specialization = +1% with a mace.

default.note: Seals, Holy Strike, Consecration, Exorcism, Holy Wrath, Holy Shield, Holy Shock, Light's Vigil, Blessings, auras, Righteous Fury, Hammer of the Righteous, Lay on Hands.

offGcd.note: These client rows carry no GCD.

attackTable.inheritedFromRogueSheet: Same level-63 table as research/rogue_forever.json for a single weapon (paladins never dual wield): 8% miss for white and special attacks (no hit suppression in game; both sims still use 9%), 6.5% dodge, 14% parry and 5% block only from the front, 40% glancing on white swings (sims 65% damage; beta ~75%, reported as a bug), melee crit minus 4.8% vs +3.

specialMiss.note: Hit cap 8% vs +3 in game, 9% in the sims.

glancing.note: 40% measured; 65% average damage is the sims' Classic value.

attackTable.frontNote: Ret attacks from behind (no parry/block); Protection tanks from the front (the boss parries 14% and blocks 5% of its attacks; boss parries speed up the boss's next swing). Beta known issue (1 Oct): enemies can parry and block from behind if you stand very close.

critMultiplier.note: Melee- and ranged-defense spells crit for 2.0x (white swings, seal procs, Judgements of Righteousness/Command/Fury, Holy Strike, Hammer of Wrath); magic-defense spells 1.5x (Holy Shock, Exorcism, Holy Wrath, Holy Shield, Light's Vigil). No paladin talent raises crit damage.

retribution.summary: Two-hander (slow is better: Seal of Righteousness and Seal of Command scale with weapon speed). Keep a seal up, Holy Strike and Judgement on cooldown, and with Twist of Light swap Seal of Command <-> Seal of Righteousness once per swing so every swing carries both seal effects. Consecration with spare mana.

twistLoop.value: Seal of Command active -> before the next swing cast Seal of Righteousness (banks Echo of Command) -> the swing gets Seal of Righteousness + an Echo of Command roll -> cast Seal of Command (banks Echo of Righteousness) -> next swing gets a Seal of Command roll + Echo of Righteousness -> repeat
twistLoop.note: gs swaps whenever the matching Echo is not already banked (mana >= 15%); fs swaps only when the next swing is < 0.4 s away. One seal cast per 3.8 s swing leaves about 1.5 free GCDs per swing.

manaModel.note: Twisting costs ~64 mana/s. Without a raid Judgement of Wisdom the Ret loses ~3,400 mana per minute and is dry in about 1.5 minutes; the gs rotation stops twisting under 15% mana and stops Consecration under 20%.

damageShare_gsRanked.unit: DPS (Undead, modeled ilvl 65, raid buffs, 300 s)
damageShare_gsRanked.note: 'Auto-attack (tag 3)' is extra swings from raid buffs (Windfury Totem is in the gs support package). Both Judgements appear because the judged seal alternates while twisting.

protection.summary: One-hander + shield, Righteous Fury on, Seal of Righteousness (gs) or Seal of Fury, Holy Shield always up, Judgement/Swift Judgement, Consecration while mana >= 30%, Holy Strike, Templar's Bulwark as the emergency button. Mana comes from blocks (Shield Specialization) and Judgement of Wisdom, so the dummy must hit you.

value: Swing timer 2.0 s (gs stress boss); parry haste when it parries you (40% of the swing, at least 20% left).
Raw damage 3000 x (U(1, 1.333) + AP/2478), AP 805 (gs stress boss, not a real Forever boss) - same as warrior_forever.md.

One attack-table roll per swing (level 63 vs 60): miss 4.4% + 0.04%/defense above 300; dodge = your dodge - 0.6%; parry = your parry - 0.6%; block = your block - 0.6% (+30% Holy Shield while it has charges, +20% Redoubt); crit 5.6% - 0.04%/defense (x2); crushing 15% (x1.5) unless the rest fills 100%; hit. Blocked hits cannot crit or crush.
Mitigation: block value subtracted from blocked hits; armor A/(A+5755); Improved Righteous Fury x0.94; Iron Creed x0.90 for 6 s after Holy Strike; Templar's Bulwark absorb.

Reactions per swing: Holy Shield charge + 221 Holy damage per block; Reckoning extra swing (40% on block, 100% when crit, 1.5 s ICD); Redoubt 10% per landed hit; Shield Specialization 6% max mana per block (3 s ICD); Seal of Fury absorb soaking the hit; Eye for an Eye if talented.
Health bar with external healing (gs: 2,500 HPS in the 3-attacker scenario, 1,500 in the warrior sheet) so Templar's Bulwark and Lay on Hands can be practised.
Threat meter: Holy damage x1.6 (Righteous Fury), Holy Shield x1.92, Holy Strike x2.0 (Iron Creed 5/5), white swings x1.0, 0.5 threat per mana except Shield Specialization/Seal of Fury mana.

foreverVsClassic: Judgement no longer consumes the seal; off the GCD; 10 s cooldown; 6% of base mana; Judgements of Righteousness/Command/Fury roll on the melee table (miss + 2.0x crit).
Judgement of the Crusader/Wisdom/Light last 40 s (Classic 10 s) and every landed melee strike refreshes them; Improved Seal of the Crusader is baked in (161).
Seal twisting is a talent (Twist of Light, Ret 31) with Echoes; seals 20% cheaper with it.
New baseline Holy Strike (8 ranks, 10 s, 50% normalized weapon + flat) and Consecration (now 12 to all + 27 at 0.095 to the first 4 per tick).
New Seal of Fury (tank seal with absorb and taunting Judgement), Swift Judgement, Templar's Bulwark, Light's Vigil, Voice of Truth.
Holy Shock: 21-point talent, 4 ranks, 10 s cooldown (was 30 s), ~10% weaker; Divine Precision can cap Holy spell hit.
Exorcism ~6%, Hammer of Wrath ~6% weaker; Holy Shield 221 damage at 0.08 (Classic 130 at 0.05), 30% block.
Righteous Fury +60% Holy threat; Improved Righteous Fury is now damage reduction; Instrument of Law cuts threat without Righteous Fury.
Redoubt procs on any landed hit (4%/point block); Reckoning on block (8%/point) or crit (20%/point) with a 1.5 s ICD; Shield Specialization returns 6% max mana per block.
Vengeance: 1/2/3% per stack, 3 stacks, 30 s, any non-periodic crit. Two-Handed Weapon Specialization 2/4/6%; One-Handed 3/7/10%.
Benediction covers all instants (2%/point); Precision gives spell hit too; Conviction now affects seal procs and Judgements.
Champion of the Light (Int -> spell damage), Holy Conduit, Sacred Arbiter, Sanctified Judgement, Consecrated Ground, Reverence, Iron Creed, Improved Seals are new.
Blessing of Kings baseline; Blessing of Sanctuary removed; Blessing of Might 133 AP (Classic rank 7: 185); Blessing of Wisdom 40 mp5; Sanctity Aura no longer trained.
Lay on Hands 20 min (was 60); Divine Shield halves your damage; Forbearance also covers Templar's Bulwark.
Retribution Aura 20 + 6% of the caster's spell power (8 Oct).
Melee hit cap 8% vs +3 (no hit suppression); gear hit/crit shared by melee and spells; spell crit 1.5x / melee-table crit 2.0x unchanged.
No downranking penalty in the client coefficients (the 1 Oct notes mention penalties; server behaviour unknown).
